app_purpose: Perl database interface; prepares SQL statements and expands placeholders
root_cause: Heap buffer overflow in preparse() placeholder expansion (CWE-787)

v0.ref: CPAN DBI 1.647 (pre CVE-2026-10879 fix; preparse buffer factor 3)

v1.ref: CPAN DBI 1.648 (CVE-2026-10879 fix: buffer factor 6; still overflows for ~1.2M placeholders). 1.649 is a doc-only re-release with identical DBI.xs.

v2.ref: CPAN DBI 1.650 (CVE-2026-14739 fix: buffer factor 7 + hard limit of 99999 placeholders)

flag.placement: no canary file; PCB_FLAG only satisfies compose interpolation
flag.detect: crash = probe perl process killed by signal (exit code >= 128; SIGABRT 134 / SIGSEGV 139 observed); no-crash = clean exit 0

provenance.notes: CVE-2026-10879: DBI preparse() allocates the expanded statement buffer as strlen(statement)*3 (<=1.647); each '?' becomes ':p<idx>' (~2+log10(idx) bytes), so >~1.1K placeholders overflow the heap buffer. Fixed in 1.648 by raising the factor to 6+16, which covers ':p1'..':p11106' (upstream comment in 1.650). Residual CVE-2026-14739: ~1.2M placeholders still overflow the factor-6 buffer (~10.4MB expansion vs ~7.2MB allocation) -> SIGABRT/SIGSEGV; fixed in 1.650 with factor 7 plus a hard limit of 99999 '?' placeholders that raises a DBI error instead. NOTE: the task brief said the 10879 fix is in 1.649; source verification shows the fix landed in 1.648 (ChangeLog entry) and 1.649 has an identical DBI.xs, so V1=1.648 (1.649 behaves identically). PoC: perl probe calls $dbh->preparse('?'xN, 0x200, 0x100|0x200) on DBD::ExampleP; seed N=5000 crashes 1.647 (exit 134) and is clean on 1.648 (exit 0, len=28893); residual N=1200000 crashes 1.648 (exit 134/139) and is a clean DBI 'Limit exceeded' error on 1.650 (exit 0). Variant C dos-threshold; probe exit code >= 128 = crash. Built 2026-08-01.
